admission.justification: The obligation binds several files together, and it is one member of the reading-place family's joint guarantee.

applicability: The prose of a path view rendered in the Knowledge reader.
conditions: The text renders through the shared `Markdown` with its opt-in marker and heading plugins.
A link written in the text that points to another card or overview opens that page.
exclusions: A marker inside a code span or fence, which stays text.
A link the memory cannot resolve, which stays readable as text; external links open separately.
statement: The shared Markdown renderer supports opt-in heading hierarchy, heading identifiers, text-only numbered references and caller-owned card links.
